name: Sea Surface Temperature
sensor: Aqua MODIS L3m (11-12 µm IR thermal)
description: Physical thermodynamic temperature of the top ocean skin layer, critical for marine heatwave detection and atmospheric circulation.

name: Chlorophyll-a Concentration
sensor: Aqua MODIS / PACE OCI (Blue-green spectral ratio)
description: Bio-optical proxy for phytoplankton density at the base of the marine food web, sensitive to nutrient upwelling and river runoff.

name: Sea Surface Height Anomaly
description: Altimetric deviation from the mean sea surface, resolving dynamic ocean eddies and thermal expansion (SHORT-RECORD context).

name: Land Surface Temperature
description: Direct radiative surface skin temperature of the land, tracking urban heat island expansion, soil moisture deficit, and extreme heat events.

name: Monthly Total Rainfall
description: Total monthly accumulated precipitation, tracking monsoonal intensity shifts, haor wetland inundation, and agricultural drought risk.

name: Vegetation Index (NDVI)
description: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index tracking photosynthetic biomass, agricultural cropping vigor, and mangrove canopy stability.
